import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0132 {A B : Type*} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0132 {A B : Type*} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b
  obtain h : ∃ a, a ∈ X ∪ Y ∧ f a = b := by
    use some a
    cases a with a ha
    exact ⟨a, ha, by simp⟩
  obtain (hX : a ∈ X) | (hY : a ∈ Y) := h.2
  · obtain hX' : f '' X ∩ {b} ≠ ∅ := by
      exact ⟨⟨_, hX⟩, by simp⟩
    obtain hX'' : f '' X ∩ {b} = {b} := by
      exact hX'
    exact hX''.1
  · obtain hY' : f '' Y ∩ {b} ≠ ∅ := by
      exact ⟨⟨_, hY⟩, by simp⟩
    obtain hY'' : f '' Y ∩ {b} = {b} := by
      exact hY'
    exact hY''.1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0132 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0132 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0132

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0132
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0132
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
